description: Poliovirus serotype 3 whole-genome multiple sequence alignment, Sabin-anchored
name: PV3_unified

parameter_departures.clade_exemplars_in_the_seed: Four RefSeq rhinovirus polyproteins join the seed alignment and are removed before backtranslation. No RV-A or RV-B record in this corpus can reach seed_min_aa, so 456 rows were aligned with no member of their own species in the seed; measured on 5.0.0, a type with no seed exemplar has residues exiled more than 200 codon columns from its own block at 8.4% against 0.14% for a type that has one.
parameter_departures.gap_extend: 0.5 on both --add passes. Upstream never set MAFFT's --ep at all, so gap *extension* sat at the default 0.123 through every build, which is what let a single unalignable fragment open a wide insertion block: opening the gap is paid for once and widening it is nearly free. Measured on POLIO_unified's real pass-1 input, CDS width goes 2465 -> 2300 aa at --ep 0.5 with --op unchanged. Raising --op instead makes it *wider* (2883 aa at 6.0), so the penalty pair is not monotonic in width and --op 4.5 is kept because it measures best.
parameter_departures.inferred_frame_by_homology: The 6-frame fallback picks the candidate ORF with the highest 6-mer containment against the corpus's own annotated proteins, where upstream picked the longest stop-free run regardless of whether it read as protein. On release 5.0.0's shipped bytes that rule chose a wrong frame for 51 EV_unified rows and 20 NPEV_unified rows, including the whole OR538731-OR538740 PV3 cluster.
parameter_departures.noncoding_records_leave_the_cds_block: A record no frame of which reads as protein is `noncoding`: it contributes no CDS row and its whole sequence is offered to the 5'NCR block instead. Upstream gave each of them a spurious >=20 aa ORF in the CDS block AND excluded them from the NCR blocks. 1,281 EV_unified rows and 855 NPEV_unified rows are affected, and 99.9% of the ones that map to a reference at all are 5'UTR amplicons.
parameter_departures.padded_assembly_gaps_leave_the_orf: A run of 30 or more wholly-ambiguous codons is dropped from the ORF before alignment. MAFFT places an X-run as residues and drags real sequence with it: PX242098 carries a 731-codon run and had 537 of 1,486 residues placed 821 columns from the rest. The count survives per record in the coverage sidecar's unsequenced_nt.
parameter_departures.pass1_gap_open: 4.5 for every unified artifact. Upstream used 3.0 for polio, which its own source documents as producing a deterministic CDS width blowup with no benefit; 4.5 was applied once as a command-line override and never propagated into the script.
parameter_departures.pass2_local_gap_open: -24.0. Upstream's shipped builds ran at MAFFT's default of -2.00 through every build, which shreds short addon fragments. This is the larger scientific change of the two.
